content_of_post_to_answer: If we dont fill our mind with useful things, will the society fill it with useless things?
answer: The mind does not remain empty for long; it naturally seeks patterns, stories, and stimulation. If we do not consciously choose what deserves our attention, the loudest voices around us will compete to fill that space. But the issue is not that society only offers useless things—curiosity, learning, and distraction all exist together. The real skill is developing the ability to choose what enters your mind, because attention is shaped by whatever we repeatedly allow to occupy it.
